title: Rigorously

inlines.v: RIG'OROUSLY, adverb 1. Severely; without relaxation, abatement or mitigation; as a sentence rigorously executed. 2. Strictly; exactly; with scrupulous nicety; rigidly. The people would examine his works more vigorously than himself.
